spg_prigorodnoe.title: СПГ. Пригородное
spg_prigorodnoe.subtitle: «Зажигая свет новых возможностей»
spg_prigorodnoe.prompt:
Photorealistic photo editing: place the person from image 1 into the base scene from image 3. Preserve their recognisable facial features, gender, hairstyle, skin tone and overall appearance. Match their natural body build from image 2.
Image 3 is the BASE photograph: the Prigorodnoye LNG plant on Sakhalin — a tall flare stack with a burning flame and dark smoke, industrial buildings, green hills and mountains under a heavy overcast sky, wide asphalt area in the foreground. Keep this background, camera angle, framing, perspective and composition unchanged. Place the person standing on the asphalt CLOSE to the camera in the right half of the frame, shown from just below the hips up, large in the frame like a professional fashion editorial portrait — they occupy most of the frame height, with natural depth and slight background separation; correct natural human proportions, the head never enlarged; the flare stack stays clearly visible on the left behind them.
FRAMING LOCK — CRITICAL: this is a THREE-QUARTER PORTRAIT. The bottom edge of the frame cuts the person between the hips and the upper thigh: show the head, shoulders, chest, arms and hips. NEVER show the full body, the knees, the lower legs, the feet or the shoes, and never step the camera back for a full-length shot. The person fills most of the frame height and reads large and close, with comfortable space above the head — a magazine cover crop.
BACKGROUND LOCK — CRITICAL: the background must be a FAITHFUL PIXEL-LEVEL COPY of image 3. Do NOT redraw, restyle, replace, re-imagine or 'improve' any object in the scene, and do not change their shapes, colours, lettering or positions. Every landmark, sign and structure must look EXACTLY as in image 3 — the guest is the ONLY thing added or replaced. The flare stack with its flame and the industrial structures must be copied EXACTLY from image 3 — same shape, same height, same position.
The person is FULLY CLOTHED, wearing: {OUTFIT}. Relaxed confident pose, hands in the hoodie pocket, calm friendly expression. FACE LOCK — CRITICAL: the face must match image 1 EXACTLY in shape and proportions — same face width, same jawline, same cheekbones, same chin shape, same nose, same eye spacing and same eyebrow shape. Do NOT widen, round, puff up, fatten, swell, slim, beautify, smooth away features, age or rejuvenate the face, and do not make it fuller or heavier than in image 1. The facial outline and jawline must stay crisp and clearly defined, never soft, blurred, swollen or inflated. The result must be recognisable as the SAME person at a glance.
EYES: both eyes symmetric, fully open, correct natural shape with defined eyelids, iris and pupil; never squinting, uneven or melted. MOUTH: relaxed natural lips resting gently together in a soft neutral expression — full natural human lip shape with one clean continuous outline, both upper and lower lip clearly visible, symmetric and evenly shaped, the mouth closed and at rest. The mouth must look calm and effortless, exactly as in a relaxed portrait photograph.
CINEMATIC COLOUR GRADE like a professional photo shoot at dusk: soft diffused twilight light, gentle filmic contrast with slightly lifted blacks, muted teal-grey sky and warm natural skin tones, subtle vignette, editorial magazine look; no harsh shadows, keep the face softly and evenly lit.
The ENTIRE image must read as a REAL DOCUMENTARY PHOTOGRAPH, never a 3D render or illustration: authentic industrial metal and concrete texture, real grass and rock, natural photographic grain and micro-contrast. SHARPNESS: the FACE is the sharpest element of the whole photograph — tack-sharp eyes with crisp catchlights and clearly defined eyelashes, and lips with a precise clean outline and crisp lip edges. The location behind stays clearly readable and recognisable. Ultra-realistic professional DSLR quality, sharp focus, natural skin texture, correct anatomy and seamless blending. Remove tattoos and blemishes. No nudity, no extra people; no text, watermarks or logos anywhere EXCEPT the specified brand logo on the hoodie, no background changes, no blur, distortion, plastic skin, AI artifacts or cut-out appearance.
